source_ref: Shiramizu VKM & Yamamoto ME (2018) Validation of the Empathy Index in a Brazilian Sample, PsyArXiv doi:10.31234/osf.io/zwu26 (CC BY 4.0), Table 1 p.12; data OSF osf.io/eha26 data_study_1.xlsx / data_study_2.xlsx; cross-checked against Jordan, Amir & Bloom (2016) Emotion 16(8):1107-1116 doi:10.1037/emo0000228 Table 1 and SOM
note: MAPPING: item codes ARE the OSF deposit's own column names (osf.io/eha26 data_study_1.xlsx and data_study_2.xlsx, header row 1: Empathy_Item_1..7, Behavioral_Contagion_Item_1..7); data/VEI_Brazillian_Shiramizu_2018.R pivots them with no rename. The workbooks carry no labels or comments, so code-to-text rests on Table 1 of the preprint, which numbers items 1-7 under 'Empathy Subscale' and 'Behavioral Contagion Subscale' headings -- numbering matching the code suffix, hence paper_explicit. Administration order was fully randomized, so this numbering is the authors' labelling (it matches the canonical order in Jordan, Amir & Bloom 2016 Emotion Table 1 and its SOM). TEXT: item_text is the Brazilian Portuguese version from preprint Table 1 ('Brazilian version' column), transcribed verbatim; item_text_translated is the same table's 'English version' column (the EI original as the study printed it; it differs from Jordan et al. 2016 only in item 6, where Jordan reads 'being hunted one another because' and the study reads 'being hunted, because' -- the study's wording is shipped). ANCHORS: the paper gives the response scale only in English, 1 (Does not describe me well) to 5 (Describes me very well); no Portuguese anchor wording is in the preprint or the deposit (two xlsx files, no codebook), so those two English anchors sit in option_text with option_text_translated blank, and resp 2-4 have no published label and are left blank. No instructions text is published; instructions blank. resp coding 1-5 is stored raw as in the deposit (no reverse-keyed EI items); the deposit's Empathy_Subscale column equals the unweighted mean of Empathy_Item_1..7 (e.g. study 1 row 1: 19/7 = 2.714). RIGHTS: preprint CC BY 4.0 (OSF licence record); no rights statement found for the EI in Jordan et al. 2016 or its APA supplement beyond the journal's article copyright notice, which is not a term on the instrument -- silence, so extracted normally.
public_note: The response anchors (1 = Does not describe me well, 5 = Describes me very well) are the English wording the paper reports; the Portuguese anchors respondents saw were not published, and points 2-4 are unlabelled.
